subdimensions.name: Suffering Detection

evidence.quote: Summary: over 900,000 Cambodian workers returned from Thailand amid border tensions, facing “urgent unmet needs” and joblessness.

subdimensions.note: The return of over 900,000 migrant workers was recorded, but needs were identified by humanitarian actors rather than through a state detection system.

subdimensions.name: Contextual Sensitivity

evidence.quote: Detainees lack protection and have minimal access to remedies.

subdimensions.note: A uniform detention regime applies regardless of whether a person is a trafficking victim or an offender.

subdimensions.name: Blind Spot Mitigation

evidence.quote: Summary: the July scam-compound crackdown appeared performative — under 20% of identified compounds were investigated and some trapped victims were not released.

subdimensions.note: No process for finding missed suffering; fewer than one in five identified scam compounds was investigated.

subdimensions.name: Signal Amplification

evidence.quote: Summary: government-aligned unions harassed and threatened legal action against the labour-rights group CENTRAL after its report on freedom-of-association violations.

subdimensions.note: Independent groups such as CENTRAL and Equitable Cambodia raise low-power concerns and are targeted for doing so.

subdimensions.name: Anticipatory Awareness

evidence.quote: Fighting in July 2025 killed and injured civilians, including children, displaced around 300,000 people, and damaged religious and cultural sites.

subdimensions.note: No pre-decision harm assessment before the 2025 border escalation, which displaced roughly 300,000 people.

subdimensions.name: Affective Resonance

evidence.quote: Detainees lack protection and have minimal access to remedies.

subdimensions.note: Trafficking victims in scam compounds are processed, not cared for; detainees "lack protection and have minimal access to remedies".

subdimensions.name: Perspective-Taking

evidence.quote: Summary: the July scam-compound crackdown appeared performative — under 20% of identified compounds were investigated and some trapped victims were not released.

subdimensions.note: Crackdown design shows no modelling of trapped victims’ experience; some were left unreleased.

subdimensions.name: Non-Judgment

evidence.quote: Civil society's ability to operate is now almost entirely constrained.

subdimensions.note: Political and labour identity attracts differential treatment; civil-society space is "almost entirely constrained".

subdimensions.name: Validation

evidence.quote: Summary: Amnesty accuses Cambodia of a “gross failure” to stop rampant abuses — torture, forced labour, trafficking and slavery — across at least 53 scam centres.

subdimensions.note: Amnesty’s findings of torture and forced labour were rejected rather than validated by government.

subdimensions.name: Cultural Empathy

evidence.quote: Summary: over 900,000 Cambodian workers returned from Thailand amid border tensions, facing “urgent unmet needs” and joblessness.

subdimensions.note: Returning migrant workers share the national language and culture, which eases reception, but their needs remain unmet.

subdimensions.name: Responsiveness

evidence.quote: Summary: the July scam-compound crackdown appeared performative — under 20% of identified compounds were investigated and some trapped victims were not released.

subdimensions.note: Raids occurred and over 3,000 people were reportedly freed, but response standards are ad hoc.

subdimensions.name: Proportionality

evidence.quote: Summary: the July scam-compound crackdown appeared performative — under 20% of identified compounds were investigated and some trapped victims were not released.

subdimensions.note: Response is calibrated to visibility rather than need; under 20% of identified compounds were investigated.

subdimensions.name: Efficacy

evidence.quote: Summary: Amnesty accuses Cambodia of a “gross failure” to stop rampant abuses — torture, forced labour, trafficking and slavery — across at least 53 scam centres.

subdimensions.note: No outcome measurement; Amnesty describes a "gross failure" to stop abuses that continue at scale.

subdimensions.note: Some resources mobilised for returning workers, far below the scale of 900,000 returnees.

subdimensions.name: Universality

subdimensions.note: Basic services nominally universal; trafficked foreign nationals in scam compounds are effectively excluded.
